Before we discuss the practical arrangements, I need each of you to go through the formal case-record disclosure step. Specifically, if either of you has made any prior informal promise to the other, or if you have any concrete operating constraints that should govern how information moves between you each week, I need you to disclose those now so the working agreement records them accurately. Let's start with you, Elena — are there any prior promises or concrete constraints on your side that need to be on the record?
